DIAGNOSIS READY: Reactive Arthritis (formerly Reiter's Syndrome).

The combination of asymmetric oligoarthritis (ankle and knee), sterile synovial fluid with significant inflammation, sterile pyuria (WBCs without bacteria), and the absence of gout or septic arthritis strongly points to this diagnosis.
